name: George
mentions: …n that they had lost their way, and, animated by the true hunter's instinct, they immediately went into camp. George still thinks there was something wrong about it.  The washouts on the railroad exceed anything known in the history of the road. Five bridges between Medora and Glendive…
George has got a penny tin whistle in full blast at the slaughter house. It can be heard quite plain for a full quarter of a mile, when the wind is in the right direction.
